name: Slanted Carousel
description: Full-screen editorial slideshow with skewed background images, a floating slanted thumbnail card, serif headings, autoplay progress rail and mouse parallax.
contents: Full-screen slides with background image, subtitle, title, description and watermark number
Slanted thumbnail card on large screens
Previous and next buttons, line indicators and autoplay progress bar
behavior: Autoplay advances slides on an interval with a progress rail
Background image shifts with mouse movement
Arrow keys and swipe change slides
Text staggers in on each slide change
editableByProps: Number of slides, all text, images and alt text
Autoplay, interval, parallax, accent and background colors

needsCodeEdit.change: Change overlay tint or text colors

fixed: Arrow keys control the slides through a window keydown listener
Injects a Google Fonts link (Playfair Display, Plus Jakarta Sans) into document head
Root is h-screen; controls are positioned inside it
